article.story: Arkansas State (4-5) at Coastal Carolina (3-6), Nov. 14 at 1 p.m. EST. Opening Line: Coastal Carolina by 1.5. Against the spread: Coastal Carolina 4-5, Arkansas State 4-5. How to watch: ESPN+ Key stats Coastal Carolina Offense Overall: 368.3 yards per game (80th in FBS) Passing: 244.3 yards per game (44th) Rushing: 124.0 yards per game (113th) Scoring: 24.7 points per game (93rd) Coastal Carolina Defense Overall: 395.6 yards per game (106th in FBS) Passing: 215.6 yards per game (67th) Rushing: 180.0 yards per game (116th) Scoring: 24.7 points per game (69th) Arkansas State Offense Overall: 371.6 yards per game (78th in FBS) Passing: 237.0 yards per game (56th) Rushing: 134.6 yards per game (99th) Scoring: 27.4 points per game (73rd) Arkansas State Defense Overall: 386.3 yards per game (98th in FBS) Passing: 182.8 yards per game (22nd) Rushing: 203.6 yards per game (129th) Scoring: 26.3 points per game (84th) Arkansas State is 126th in defensive third down percentage, allowing opponents to convert 43.8% of the time. Coastal Carolina ranks 123rd on offense, converting on 32.5% of third downs. Coastal Carolina is 96th in the FBS with a -3 turnover margin, compared to Arkansas State's 23rd-ranked +5 margin. Coastal Carolina ranks 83rd in the FBS averaging 60.0 penalty yards per game, compared to Arkansas State's 22nd-ranked 44.4 per-game average. Coastal Carolina ranks 134th in FBS in red zone offense, scoring on 68.2% of trips. Arkansas State's red zone defense ranks 90th at 86.7%. Team leaders Coastal Carolina Passing: Deuce Bailey, 2,178 yards, 19 TDs, 9 INTs, 55.2 completion percentage Rushing: Dominic Knicely, 498 yards on 102 carries, 3 TDs Receiving: Clayton Coppock Jr., 408 yards on 24 catches, 5 TDs Arkansas State Passing: Trey Owens, 2,133 yards, 12 TDs, 8 INTs, 66.8 completion percentage Rushing: Solomon Baggett, 344 yards on 76 carries, 2 TDs Receiving: Jaylen Bonelli, 518 yards on 34 catches, 3 TDs Last game Coastal Carolina fell to Old Dominion 21-8 on Nov. 7. Bailey threw for 233 yards on 17-of-33 attempts (51.5%) with no touchdowns and three interceptions. Jaden Allen-Hendrix had 24 rushing yards on five carries. Karmello English put up 57 yards on five catches. Arkansas State fell 19-17 to UL Monroe on Nov. 7. Owens led Arkansas State with 193 yards on 16-of-29 passing (55.2%) for one touchdown and two interceptions. He also carried the ball 10 times for 67 yards. Baggett carried the ball eight times for 38 yards. Bonelli had three receptions for 66 yards. Next game Coastal Carolina plays at Louisiana on Nov. 21. Arkansas State plays at Louisiana Tech on Nov. 21.
